title.narrative: Contribute to the national goals of ending AIDS by 2030, and TB elimination by 2025 - India (01-Apr-2024-31-Mar-2027)

description.narrative: India, TB/HIV, Solidarity and Action Against The HIV Infection in India (SAATHII)This program has the following goals: The goal of the project is to contribute to the national goal of ending AIDS by 2030. The program will support NACO's expansion of its new model for a comprehensive continuum of care from prevention to treatment.. To reduce morbidity and mortality due to TB and contribute to achieving National TB Program's goal of elimination by 2025. The objectives of this program are: Increase the proportion of prison inmates and those at OCS who know their HIV status from 56% to 100% in 10 states/UTs. Increase the proportion of other vulnerable populations (spouses and family members, and partners of PLHIV) who know their HIV status from 43% to 73% in 10 states/UTs. Increase the proportion of HIV-exposed infants who received the virological test within 6 months of birth from 92% to 100% in 10 states/Uts. Increase the proportion of PLHIV LFU to ART Center tracked back with definite outcome from 50% to 98% in 10 states/UTs. Increase the proportion of PLHIV due for VL test that have been tested for VL from 60% to 95%. Increase the pediatric TB case notification in nine states from 59219 (2022) to 74170 (2026-27). Increase the pediatric TB treatment success rate in nine states from 90% (2021) to 92% (2026-27). Increase the annual TB case notification by 4564 in 60 districts of 8 states through deployment of portable handheld X-ray device as part of TB case finding activities. Increase the annual TB case notification among the prisoners from 18 to 142 in 10 states and UTs by March 2027
